scope: Define benchmark rules before any calibration, validation, or holdout score is calculated.

B0.name: HISTORICAL_RATE
B0.rule: Estimate the target-event rate using calibration data only, separately for each spatial band. Convert the rate to a probability for each 3, 7, and 10 day window using p = 1 - exp(-lambda * duration_days). Do not refit lambda in validation or holdout.

B1.name: RECENT_ACTIVITY_PERSISTENCE
B1.trigger_rule: Any event with magnitude >= 4.5 inside the evaluated corridor-distance band opens a forecast window after the event.
B1.window_rule: Use the same 3, 7, and 10 day windows. Overlapping triggers do not open or extend another window; the first event anchors the active window.
B1.target_rule: The trigger event cannot score as its own target. Score only later qualifying events.

C0.name: AREA_MATCHED_CONTROL
C0.geometry_rule: Create a control copy of PER-NORTE-01 V1 by subtracting 5.0 decimal degrees from every latitude while preserving all longitudes and vertex order.
C0.reason: The translated line preserves corridor length and shape approximately and places the control farther south along the same broad Peru subduction margin without fitting to earthquake outcomes.
C0.scoring_rule: Apply the same primary and exploratory deep-trigger rules, time windows, distance bands, deduplication rules, and target thresholds used for PER-NORTE-01.
limitations: The translation is a geometric control, not an official tectonic corridor.
No control geometry changes are allowed after freeze.

comparison_rule.primary_question: Does PER-NORTE-01 outperform B0, B1, and C0 on validation and holdout without parameter changes?
comparison_rule.minimum_reporting: Report every benchmark and every sensitivity combination, not only the best result.
comparison_rule.no_claim_rule: No predictive-skill claim is allowed if PER-NORTE-01 does not consistently outperform benchmarks on validation and holdout.

prohibited_changes_after_freeze: Changing the B0 calibration rate after viewing validation or holdout.
Changing the B1 trigger or overlap rule.
Moving, rotating, reshaping, or resizing C0.
Selecting only favorable windows or distance bands.
Removing unsuccessful forecasts or missed target events.
warning_text: Modelo experimental para investigacion retrospectiva. No constituye una alerta oficial, una prediccion determinista ni sustituye la informacion del IGP/CENSIS y otras autoridades competentes.
